description: Checkout Page helps merchants create and update checkout pages, event registration pages, and forms; manage customer and booking records; and review payments, subscriptions, and invoices. It also supports coupons, fixed tax rates, uploaded assets, and webhook configuration. Subscription cancellation is prepared for completion in the dashboard.

defaultPrompt: Create an event page for our spring gala with Early Bird, Standard and VIP tickets.
